File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function retrySchedule(initial: number, maximum: number, attempts: number): number[] | null
Behavior: Reject negative attempts or an initial delay above the maximum. Return exactly attempts delays, starting at initial and doubling each time but saturating at maximum without arithmetic overflow.
Visible example: initial 3, maximum 10, attempts 5 returns [3,6,10,10,10].
